project_name: FAE Clarke LLC Old Elberton Road Data Center
aliases: FAE Clark LLC Athens data center
status_detail: Athens-Clarke County staff report covered a 233.09-acre rezone at 0 Old Elberton Road with conceptual plan just over 2 million square feet across four buildings; the Mayor and Commission later denied the proposal on October 7, 2025.
notes: Official staff report lists owner as FAE Clarke, LLC and applicant William Diehl; DCD identifies the intended use as a data center and says end-user was undisclosed.

status_detail: No confirmed project/application found; a 719-acre Bluffton/Mill Pond Road assemblage is being marketed for data center and battery storage use but appears to be a site listing, not a project.
notes: Kept as no_projects_found because sources are commercial real-estate marketing only; no developer, permit, DRI, or county approval identified.

project_name: TA Realty East Tanners Church Road Data Center
aliases: TA Realty Clayton County data center
status_detail: Clayton County says a TA Realty data center in unincorporated Ellenwood was approved in the past year; Invest Clayton/AJC report a $959M, 180 MW project along East Tanners Church Road with an incentive package approved in June 2025.
notes: County moratorium does not unwind previously approved projects; AJC reports site plan approval in October 2024 and 10-year tax abatement details were not disclosed.

project_name: Digital Realty Fort Gillem Data Center
status_detail: Digital Realty's project page describes a proposed two-facility Fort Gillem campus on 97 acres with first phase expected to open in early 2028 and about 212 MW initial IT load.
notes: County release says Digital Realty will construct a campus within Forest Park city limits at former Fort Gillem; Digital Realty states about $3B investment and 1.9M sq ft.

status_detail: Developers withdrew plans for a 15-building, 403-acre data center campus on Panhandle Road; Lovejoy city council accepted the withdrawal on August 6, 2026 and said it would revise zoning to exclude data centers.
notes: WABE reports the site was across from Eddie White Middle and Michelle Obama Elementary; earlier WABE coverage says it was under DRI review and had been annexed/rezoned after an earlier residential concept.
